labeling_rule: The role of the gold article decides: an 'Implement' type story → the article documents the implementation of the integration (Technical Implementation, payloads, script names) → 'developer'. A 'Fix/Resolve' type story → the article is a troubleshooting guide (Investigation Steps, Known Issues) for the support work → 'helpdesk'. The 'Who uses it' row is a secondary piece of evidence; none of the gold examples addresses a purely end-user reader.
